integrity: The theorem is proved from exact modular-congruence counting and the Chinese remainder theorem. Finite computation is used only as an independent replay of small and medium cases.
scientific_limitations: The explicit product formula is proved for integer residue rings Z_n; arbitrary finite commutative rings retain only the annihilator-sum identity without a universal product evaluation.
The literature search cannot exclude an equivalent edge-count identity published only under a different graph name such as zero-product graph.
title: A general Wiener formula for prime graphs of integer residue rings
